newsitem.title: FINLAND: HELSINKI CLINGS TO GAINS, SEEN FRAGILE AHEAD US CPI.
newsitem.headline: HELSINKI CLINGS TO GAINS, SEEN FRAGILE AHEAD US CPI.

text.p: Shares clung to minor gains in
vacant trade on Tuesday with investors on hold ahead of key U.S.
"The focus is on the figures," one broker said, referring
to the U.S. CPI figures due at 1230 GMT.
"We are waiting for some kind of direction... the general
impression is that it will be down," one broker said.
Nokia traded up 1.00 markka at 295.00 after touching 296.00
earlier in the session in modest trade.
